module: Flowgraph node "RT Message" (category repeat_instant, tags ui/text): displays a real-time message ('ScenarioRealtimeDisplay' hook). Inputs: "message" (any or translationObject table {txt, context}), "clear" (pulse). The message must be cleared manually; it is also cleared when the graph stops.

work.desc: Clears or displays the message depending on 'clear' and the input flow.
